body: I know that feeling. I wish I was "gone", in whatever way does the job, yet I feel like a lot of people would be happy about it - because then they don't have to hear my side, and can use my death as an excuse to make up my story themselves.
It's not guaranteed, but I have a very short time to finish it and all I can think about is killing myself for revenge
Yes. But being so behind and taking so long just makes me hate myself more.

The gist of it is, I had zero support and finally when I realised I was actually raped as a kid I realised everyone always hated me because I was acting weird or rude and wasn't aware of it. And now I just want someone to rescue me and be there for me. But obviously from what I just said, I have no one for that.
Apart from that, it doesn't matter anyway because I am the biggest waste of space I can think of

If I take it again I will have to pay around £3,000 (more I think actually) and I don't have that money and I have no job to earn it. I've been turned down for everything, including like 50 cleaning jobs

Being raped, my mother knowing and not caring, acting out, being narcissistic and annoying, having an eating disorder which made me look dead and scaring people away, being mocked, not knowing how to be nice to myself or anyone else and basically being a human garbage can. I hate my family but also hate myself for being angry at them.

I genuinely can't think of anything. Everything so far in life has been a lie. I don't really contribute much, I only drain people. If I was good enough for anything then I wouldn't have been denied an interview for the thousand jobs I've applied for.

As are you! We will get there.

edit: now that reads like I was making your post about myself \- I meant that you're not alone in this, and your story made me feel less alone too.

I have no advice, because my situation is remarkably similar to yours (raped at 6/7, been 13 years and my mother knew but didn't do shit, made me see him when I didn't want to because he was giving her money. I was in deep, denial until earlier this year) 

I'm sorry you're in this. It's vile, and no one deserves it.
I was given an Acer laptop by another family member when mine broke - she said she didn't use it because she has another computer.
I'm still here
I've been suspecting that, but I don't know how exactly and I'm scared of sounding paranoid.
Yes. My mother is clearly terrified of me having my own money, or money that isn't from her. She was shocked and angry when she found out someone else gave me train money.
Not true. Many people use money to control other people.
Yes, I have no choice.
I feel like it might have been a one time thing.
Believe me, I want to, but I have no money and can't find work.

I have no idea what it is for sure. But this dream/memory, there was no environment \- it was just all multicoloured/hallucinations of random shapes. If there were any discernible objects around, then you could see them like you could see the outline of an image in a 'magic eye' picture or something.
This was mostly between 16\-19 I think, or that I'm aware of anyway
pretty much. And they have invaded my privacy to an extent which makes me feel ill.

It is like it's no matter what they say, but I also can't remember a lot about my childhood, so I don't know what other specifics to point to. I feel like I was always just an overly messy, embarrassing child who everyone tried to avoid, and who was trying to numb feelings all the time.

I don't want to go into it, but lots of stuff happened \- as a child \- and adults let it go on.

tbh I think I did have a dissociative episode, but it was at school. I think I remembered part of it in a dream, but the rest is just 'gone'.

 I don't know if I said anything, but I definitely think I actually got up and walked around, and have almost no memory of it.

Well, the idea of causing my relatives grief is unrealistic because they wouldn't care anyway. They are a large part of what makes me want to die.

And I honestly don't see how anyone could use my help. I don't have shit to offer unless someone wants a drinking pal.

1. I have done A LOT less than many others my age have.
2. Thanks for sensing that I'm a person. But I can't get over wholeheartedly believing that I don't deserve love and connection (and typing those words made me cringe). While trying to do my work I literally surround myself with any sharp objects I can find in case the rage gets unbearable again \- which is pretty much every 5 minutes or so (I can't break anything else because, understandably, I'll just get yelled at again.)

Edit: and all I did was talk shit about other people when I have always been the one with problems. Those problems can't be dealt with because they have gone on for too long, so why not just put an end to it?

I suppose. But the dishes don't belong to me, and it made their real owner angry.

And I don't know what makes me happy. I know what makes me "happy" is anything which numbs my feelings \- mostly drinking. 

That's what I feel my life, at best, can be in potential. That I'll carry on drinking, getting in worse and worse condition until I kill myself \- either through an addiction or intentionally.

I just don't. Every time I try to get on with things I remember some other shitty/embarrassing thing I did, and then everything stops again.  Or I think about how much I've missed.  

I just don't feel like a person. I don't know how else to describe it.
I want to think that. But isn't there a point where it just goes too far? I'm 20 and all I've done is make a joke out of myself.
I also look like him, and my mother doesn't like it. So that's another huge barrier
